0.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETTREASUREMAP_00172_AURIANA_000_000
0.description: Looking to get your hands on some alexandrite, are you? I have a map right here which should lead you to a buried cache. For 75 <hex:023111FF054974656D04FF06E380803238030203>, it's yours.
0.translation_description: Cerchi dell'Alexandrite, eh? Ho qui una mappa che dovrebbe condurti a un tesoro sepolto. Per 75 <hex:023111FF054974656D04FF06E380803238030203>, è tua.

4.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETTREASUREMAP_00172_AURIANA_000_005
4.description: Here─sealed for your peace of mind. You may decipher it at your leisure.
4.translation_description: Eccola─sigillata, così non dovrai preoccuparti. Potrai decifrarla con calma.

5.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETTREASUREMAP_00172_AURIANA_000_010
5.description: You've a mind to acquire some alexandrite, do you? I've none in my possession, but I do have a map or two which might lead you to a cache─provided you can decipher them.
5.translation_description: Vuoi procurarti dell'Alexandrite? Non ne ho qui con me, ma ho una o due mappe che potrebbero condurti a un tesoro─a patto che tu sappia decifrarle.

6.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETTREASUREMAP_00172_AURIANA_000_011
6.description: ...Judging from the way you cocked your head just now, you haven't the foggiest what I'm talking about. Come back when you do.
6.translation_description: ...A giudicare da come hai appena inclinato la testa, non hai la minima idea di cosa stia dicendo. Torna quando lo saprai.

7.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETTREASUREMAP_00172_SYSTEM_000_020
7.description: You cannot purchase mysterious maps until you have learned the general action <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Decipher<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
7.translation_description: Non puoi acquistare mappe misteriose finché non hai imparato l'azione generale <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Decifra<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

8.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETTREASUREMAP_00172_SYSTEM_000_021
8.description: To do so, you must first complete the quest “Treasures and Tribulations.”
8.translation_description: Per farlo, devi prima completare la missione «Tesori e tribolazioni».

9.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETTREASUREMAP_00172_AURIANA_000_030
9.description: Much as I'd love to help you indulge your impulses, I cannot sell you another mysterious map until you decipher the one in your possession.
9.translation_description: Mi piacerebbe assecondare i tuoi capricci, ma non posso venderti un'altra mappa misteriosa finché non avrai decifrato quella che già possiedi.

10.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030GETTREASUREMAP_00172_AURIANA_000_050
10.description: The price is not negotiable─75 <hex:023111FF054974656D04FF06E380803238030203>, and not one less.
10.translation_description: Il prezzo non è trattabile─75 <hex:023111FF054974656D04FF06E380803238030203>, neanche un gil di meno.
